mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 30 days compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05% over 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% indicates economic distress that depresses corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a misallocation of demand that erodes corporate profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises and RSAFS falls.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates overcapacity and weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) over the prior two quarters indicates robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 increases by at least 0.5% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS rising) combined with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a favorable economic environment that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-consumption regimes (RSAFS > 450,000), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a housing sector slowdown that depresses equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 450,000 and HOUST declines.
